exposure: GDM compensated by insulin treatment (GDM G2)
outcome: Secretory immunoglobulin A (SIgA) concentrations in milk
cohort: The study included 53 hyperglycemic mothers and 49 normoglycemic mothers.
finding: Gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) generally does not significantly impact the immunological quality of early milk, as there were no major differences in lactoferrin (LF) and immunoglobulin concentrations between hyperglycemic and normoglycemic mothers, though insulin-treated GDM mothers showed higher early colostral IgG and colostral LF compared to diet-controlled GDM mothers.
